checks.title: AI assistants can fetch the page
checks.recommendation: AI assistants fetch pages when a shopper asks about them. Allow ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and Perplexity-User in your WAF or bot-management rules (most vendors have a "verified AI bots" category) and check that robots.txt does not disallow them.

checks.title: AI search crawlers can fetch the page
checks.recommendation: AI search indexes decide which products get cited. Allow OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot in robots.txt and your firewall. You can still block training crawlers such as GPTBot separately.

checks.title: No bot challenges for AI agents
checks.recommendation: Agents cannot solve CAPTCHAs or JavaScript challenges. Skip challenges for verified AI user agents, or allow-list their published IP ranges, instead of challenging every request.
